LanguageData.Raven_Building_MineralExtractor.label: [Raven] Mineral Extractor
LanguageData.Raven_Building_MineralExtractor.descript: Raven fluid industrial equipment used for processing liquid lava and extracting basic minerals. The machine supports four extraction modes: steel, silver, jade, and gold. The casing and decals have been integrated into the official industrial texture structure, allowing for further texture fine-tuning later.
